fact: At a SERNIE workshop on 4 and 5 February 2026, attended by the ministry's technical and financial partners, SERNIE's director set out the service's priorities as following the Plan quinquennal 2024-2029, and EDUSER was presented as an application developed by SERNIE's own IT staff to identify learners nationally, its deployment still under discussion; the service reported no real-time data return, unsuitable IT tools and a lack of operational partners.
title: SERNIE: Atelier sur les fonctionnalités pour une modernisation du système éducatif
publisher: Ministère de l'Éducation nationale et Nouvelle Citoyenneté
